name: Dogfood: gradle check
description: Run the repo quality gates as a staged, fail-fast Yukta workflow.

tool.description: Run one shell command (gradle, go, pnpm, ...) in one project, once. The caller decides what a failure means. An empty command passes with a warning.

command: { [ -n "$YUKTA_TOOL_COMMAND" ] && [ "$YUKTA_TOOL_COMMAND" != - ]; } || { echo "tool $YUKTA_TOOL_LABEL: nothing to run"; exit 0; }; eval "$YUKTA_TOOL_COMMAND"

config.reason: the command exited non-zero or timed out

check.description: The scoped, self-healing quality gate: one tool call per planned stage, a failed stage goes to heal (yk check)

claude.description: One headless Claude Code session in a project; returns its JSON answer and what it cost.

config.reason: the claude session failed, ran out of budget or ran out of time

attempt.description: One repair attempt: one Claude session at one model and effort, judged by re-running the failed stage.

config.reason: the attempt did not fix the stage

heal.description: Repair a failed stage: the free automatic fix first, then triage and the model ladder, escalating on failure.

config.reason: the stage already fails the same way on origin/main: a known baseline failure, no fixer was started

config.question: How hard is it to fix this failed check of a software project? Judge the work a fix needs, not how scary the message looks.

labels.easy: A mechanical or small obvious fix: formatting, an import, a license header, a typo, a missing semicolon, a style or analyzer finding in one file, a type or signature change at a few call sites.
labels.average: One failing test or runtime error whose cause is visible, or a few classes and tests to change together, or tests to add (a coverage threshold missed).
labels.hard: Needs investigation: many failing tests with one shared cause, concurrency, flaky or timing or order-dependent failures, memory, a migration or a build-wide change.

mapping.problems: payload['results'] == null ? payload['problems'] : (payload['results'].size() > 0 ? payload['results'][0]['output']['problems'] : 'The previous attempt did not finish: ' + payload['reason'])
mapping.previous: payload['results'] == null ? 'The previous attempt ran out of time.' : (payload['results'].size() > 0 ? payload['results'][0]['output']['summary'] : '')

config.reason: every model failed at every effort
